name: Homowo
description: A harvest festival commemorating the overcoming of hunger. It includes traditional ceremonies, food and community celebrations.
period: Usually around August or September; dates vary by traditional area.

name: Chale Wote Street Art Festival
description: A contemporary street art and cultural festival featuring visual arts, performance, music and public installations.
period: Usually held annually; confirm the current programme.

name: Akwasidae
description: A traditional royal observance connected to the Asante calendar, ancestral remembrance and customary practices.

name: Adae Kese
description: A major Asante traditional celebration associated with the royal and ancestral calendar.
period: Not an annual fixed-date event; confirm with official cultural sources.

name: Odwira
description: A traditional purification and harvest festival with customary rites, durbars and community celebrations.
period: Often around September or October; dates vary.

name: Aboakyer
description: A traditional deer-hunting festival celebrated in Winneba, with processions and community ceremonies.

name: Fetu Afahye
description: A major Cape Coast festival involving traditional rites, a durbar and cultural celebrations.

name: Bakatue
description: A festival marking the opening of the Benya Lagoon for fishing, with traditional ceremonies and a durbar.

name: Hogbetsotso
description: A festival commemorating the migration history of the Anlo people, with cultural activities and a durbar.

name: Damba
description: A traditional festival with drumming, dancing, horse displays and customary ceremonies. Practices differ between communities.
period: Follows the Islamic and traditional calendars; dates vary.

name: Bugum (Fire Festival)
description: A traditional fire festival observed in several northern communities.
period: Date follows the Islamic lunar calendar; confirm locally.

name: Feok
description: A traditional festival associated with Builsa history, identity and community celebration.
period: Often around December; confirm local dates.

name: Kobine
description: A cultural festival associated with Dagaaba music, dance, food and community identity.

name: Apoo
description: A traditional festival associated with purification, social reflection and community celebration.
period: Often around March or April; confirm local dates.
